entry.title: Updated: dsh-swarm-router
entry.summary: Sub-agent matrix swarm that routes heterogeneous tasks to the most suitable model from an OpenRouter-like gateway plus cfgpu.com/llm/square, dispatches each via in-process subagents or direct LLM calls, and tracks per-model token consumption with a feedback-driven ranking. Exact install spec: github:r600a-code/dsh-swarm-router. Source event: zoahdev/dsh-subscribe; changed: sources.
